name: Summer Fun in the Arts
description_short: An eight week summer arts program at the Hopkinton Center for the Arts for kids and teens in grades K to 12, with weekly half day and full day classes in ceramics, dance, music, theater, visual arts and filmmaking, plus outdoor time and an end of week performance.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds less a $50 cancellation fee until May 31; none after. Switching weeks costs $25 when space allows.
notes: 2027 registration opens December 28, 2026. Weekly prices are in the class catalog, which refused our fetcher (429), so none recorded. Most programs meet at 98 Hayden Rowe, Hopkinton (pick up 3 pm in the amphitheater); some at 34 Hayden Rowe and at the HCA Community Kiln, 46 Park Street, Framingham. Families send lunch and snacks; the center serves no food. Need based scholarships for Hopkinton and nearby MetroWest residents.
